name: Effect: drum head (body)
notes: Your playing shakes a tight drum head whose lowest mode is A2 (110 Hz): a short, boomy ring with a tone under every note, like a banjo or a frame drum. An effect for in front of any amp: no amp, no cab, auto level off. Physics: a round membrane held at its edge (its modes are the zeros of the Bessel functions: 1, 1.59, 2.14, 2.30 ... x the lowest). Simplified: every mode is shaken and heard equally. Change Lowest mode in the chain editor to tune it.
